title: Not exactly as advertised
text: Not exactly as advertised. The ad is a tad misleading.  I thought the clearance would be 5", but there is a support bar that runs under the shelf leaving the clearance must less than 5".  Otherwise, it's built fairly sturdy, and looks okay, too.

product_metadata.title: Convenience Concepts Small Designs2Go Monitor Riser for TVs up to 26 Inches, Black
features: COLLECTION PIECE: Introducing the Design2Go Collection - Elevate your home décor with stylish and functional furniture pieces that are perfect for any home decor.
MULTIPLE FINISHES: Choose from a variety of finishes to perfectly complement your contemporary, modern or minimalist styled home!
VERSATILE: This riser looks great in the living room or office! Also works as a PC monitor riser!
QUALITY MATERIAL: Built from manufactured wood, finished with a smooth melamine veneer, and includes a support bar to help with weight.
EASY ASSEMBLY: This tv riser is easy to assemble with instructions provided, making it a hassle-free addition to your home.
PERFECT SIZE: Perfectly sized to fit any room, this piece measures (L) 23.75 in. x (W) 15.75 in. x (H) 6.5 in. Providing a stylish and functional space to enjoy movie nights and gaming sessions.
COLOR VARIATION: Please note that the color may vary slightly due to photography lighting or monitor display.
description: Need to add some height to your entertainment center? The Designs2Go Small TV/Monitor Riser for TVs up to 26 Inches by Convenience Concepts will fix this problem! Whether adding height to a TV or computer monitor, this sturdy riser is the solution. Additional underneath space offers room to store a cable box, gaming system, or even a keyboard. This transitional riser is built from particleboard, finished with a smooth melamine veneer, and includes a support bar to help with weight. Assemble in minutes and pair with coordinating Designs2Go TV stands or desks to complete your home look, each sold separately.
